question: What is the full form of ‘ICC’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**International Cricket Council**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) is the global governing body for cricket.
 
• It was founded as the Imperial Cricket Conference in 1909 by representatives from Australia, England, and South Africa.
 
• In 1965, it was renamed the International Cricket Conference, and in 1989, it became the International Cricket Council.
 
• The ICC's headquarters are located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC's Role and Functions:**

 
 
• The ICC is responsible for the organization and governance of cricket's major international tournaments, including the Cricket World Cup and the ICC T20 World Cup.
 
• It sets and enforces the rules of the game and ensures the integrity of cricket through anti-corruption measures and drug testing.
 
• The ICC also provides ratings for the teams and players in international cricket.
 
• It promotes and develops the game globally, working with member countries to grow cricket at all levels.
 
 
 
• **Membership:**
 
 
• The ICC has three categories of membership: Full Members, Associate Members, and Affiliate Members.
 
• Full Members are the governing bodies for cricket in their respective countries and are eligible to play Test cricket.
 
• Associate Members are the governing bodies for cricket in countries where the sport is firmly established and organized but not yet granted Full Member status.
 
• Affiliate Members are the governing bodies for cricket in countries where the sport is played according to the ICC's rules but is still developing.
 
 
 
• **Major ICC Tournaments:**
 
 
• **Cricket World Cup:** The ICC organizes the Cricket World Cup, which is held every four years and is the sport's premier one-day international (ODI) tournament.
 
• **ICC T20 World Cup:** This tournament is the premier international championship of Twenty20 cricket and is held every two years.
 
• **ICC Champions Trophy:** This is a one-day international (ODI) cricket tournament that was last held in 2017.
 
• **ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup:** This tournament is organized for national teams with players under the age of 19 and is held every two years.
